paper_title: Constraints on Light Dark Matter Particles Interacting with Electrons from DAMIC at SNOLAB
coupling_convention: dimensionless kinetic mixing kappa (same as chi/epsilon)
notes: DAMIC at SNOLAB (arXiv:1907.12628) reports new 90% C.L. direct-detection limits on hidden-photon (dark photon) DM kinetic mixing kappa for masses 1.2-30 eV (Fig. 4), claiming best direct-detection limits in 1.2-9 eV. The paper also constrains DM-electron scattering cross section sigma_e for 0.6-100 MeV masses (Fig. 3), but sigma_e is not among the supported coupling types, so the hidden-photon kappa result is extracted. No numerical table is provided; the kappa values listed here are approximate reconstructions of the Fig. 4 exclusion curve shape (kappa ~1e-14 at minimum near ~5-10 eV, rising steeply toward the Si band gap at ~1.2 eV), hence the reduced extraction confidence. Halo parameters: rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, v0 = 220 km/s, vesc = 544 km/s.
